whatIs.title: What is HeyMaa?
whatIs.body:
A smart, dedicated assistant for the demanding yet wonderful everyday life of motherhood.

You talk, write or send a photo — whenever you want, whenever you can, whenever you need to.

HeyMaa organises and saves your moments into one continuous story.
Not perfect, but real.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: HeyMaa Subscription
pricing.subtitle: Choose the plan that fits you

items.question: What does the free trial include?
items.answer: 14 days full access to all features — unlimited chat, voice messages with usage limits, basic memory. No card needed to get started.

items.question: Does HeyMaa give medical advice?
items.answer: Never. That is a core design principle for us. For anything related to the health of you or your child, HeyMaa refers you exclusively to a doctor or pharmacist.

items.question: Which languages does it support?
items.answer: 15 languages — Greek, English, Arabic, Chinese, Spanish, French, Romanian, Polish, Turkish, Japanese, Russian, German, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch. The UI and chat switch to your selected language.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
items.answer: Of course! You stay in full control. You can stop your monthly subscription whenever you want from your profile settings. With the annual plan, you keep the discounted price (-57%) and cancellation stops auto-renewal. You keep full access until your plan expires.
